name: Soil nitrate (NO3-), plant-available nitrogen
source: Nitrate anion NO3-, formula mass 62.004 from IUPAC standard atomic weights (N 14.007, O 15.999 x3). N fraction 14.007/62.004 = 22.5905%.
notes: Modelled as the mass of the nitrate ion itself, independent of the counter-cation (K+, Ca2+, etc.) that carries it in the soil solution, so this substance composes with any soil cation pool without double-counting mass. N is rounded to the nearest microgram; O closes exactly.
